name: Inactive Property Alert
title: Production stale property alerting
notes: Added automated stale-property scanning using configurable inactivity threshold (InactivityDays).
Pulls keyholder citizen IDs from the properties table and resolves player names from the players table.
Sends formatted Discord embeds with per-property keyholder lists, including optional role mention support.
Includes batching to avoid oversized Discord messages (MaxPropsPerMessage).
Configurable schedule controls: interval checks (CheckIntervalMinutes) and optional hour-only runs (RunOnlyAtHour).
Added console-only command: stalepropertyowners (manual run on demand).
Integrated Pigeon Studios Group version checking on resource start.
Added README documentation for setup and support.
